text: 深成指、创业板指均跌超1%，中国银行、工商银行再创新高。 港股冲高回落，恒指半日涨0.2%，恒生科技指数跌0.6%，小米、华虹宏力跌超4%。 李强将出席第140届广交会开幕式及相关活动。 中央政法委印发《关于依法从严查处危害食品安全违法犯罪的意见》。 北京警方对宜信相关公司立案侦查，对实控人等采取刑事强制措施。 沪深两市融资余额上周五减少145.81亿元。 印度央行采取措施捍卫本币，印度卢比兑美元上涨1%。
text_en: The Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both fell more than 1%, while Bank of China and ICBC hit new highs again. Hong Kong stocks rose then pulled back, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.2% at midday and the Hang Seng Tech Index down 0.6%; Xiaomi and Hua Hong Semiconductor fell more than 4%. Li Qiang will attend the opening ceremony of the 140th Canton Fair and related activities. The Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission issued the "Opinions on Strictly Investigating and Handling Illegal and Criminal Acts Endangering Food Safety in Accordance with the Law." Beijing police opened an investigation into companies related to CreditEase and took criminal coercive measures against the actual controller and others. Margin balances in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets decreased by 14.581 billion yuan last Friday. India's central bank took measures to defend the local currency, and the Indian rupee rose 1% against the US dollar.
